title: MC Royale
body:
My Minecraft Server Modpack for Minecraft Forge 1.21.1 Requires Medium Specs to Play
Server Is quite unfinished but there is one finished map Trench Warfare but there is only one map done so i will have to make it more so FFA for now.
Discord: https://discord.gg/y68Y5vs5eC

This Action Packed Modpack (for a MC Server) adds Guns Galore! and includes 2 maps one in heavy alpha and the other done
Shaders Are Pre-installed, But Sadly it will not be getting updated to the Latest version or any newer versions because it will either cause me to give up updating due to issues with version incompatibilities or Being Unstable as right now the server is Stable with the current mods it is just being built but im sure if you Like FPS games you will certainly love this!
